name: Glade and Ritual
storyline:
All the critters of The Glade lived a peaceful life. In the centre of the village a magic blue flower grew, every night the critters performed a ritual to keep the flower healthy. In return the flower granted them protection from the dangers of the forest floor.

One day, the sacred flower lost a single petal, who's to blame?

...and how many days do they have left?
summary: Glade and Ritual is a cute and short story game with some Breakout-meets-Peggle style minigames. You play as a gnome who is in charge of a small village with various bug inhabitants. In the centre of the village a magic flower grows. Every night the villagers come together to perform a ritual and in return the magic flower protects the village. However the flower starts loosing it's petals once a day, leading to chaos and tension between the villagers.
